title: HTTP Cache-Control Headers — Companion Files
description: Working examples of HTTP caching headers for static assets and API responses: nginx location block, an Express app with immutable assets, ETag/Last-Modified conditional requests and stale-while-revalidate, and a FastAPI app with a Cache-Control middleware.
description_es: Ejemplos funcionales de headers de caché HTTP para assets estáticos y respuestas de API: bloque location de nginx, app Express con assets immutable, peticiones condicionales ETag/Last-Modified y stale-while-revalidate, y app FastAPI con middleware de Cache-Control.
